newsitem.title: LATVIA: NEW OIL PIPELINE PLANNED TO BY-PASS LITHUANIA.
newsitem.headline: NEW OIL PIPELINE PLANNED TO BY-PASS LITHUANIA.

text.p: Latvia's Transit Business Association said on Wednesday that the country's transport ministry planned to build a new oil pipeline directly to Russia, by-passing Lithuania.

"Latvia's transport ministry...has in principle approved of the setting up of a stock company for building a new oil pipeline (to Ventspils port), by-passing Lithuanian territory," Aivars Lembergs, the president of Latvia's Transit Business Association, told a transit conference.
"We need to do this in order to be independent from any decisions on transit tariffs and to allow Russian oil to reach world markets at the most competitive price," he said.
"Lithuania has been introducing tariffs which have not been favourable to Latvia or Russia," he added.
The current pipleline from Russia to Ventspils, the biggest outlet for Russian crude and oil products in the region, passes through Lithuania.
